goal: Allow separate processes to query chain data and follow chain events via IPC
Enable running the Bitcoin Core wallet in a distinct process
Provide a stable IPC interface for third-party tools while keeping internal wallet APIs flexible
reviewability: Ready to review; nothing known that would invalidate current review
agreement: Broad support with multiple tested ACKs, including Rust wallet and Electrs demos (darosior, enirox001, Sjors)
Concept approval for unblocking process separation and external indexers (ariard, willcl-ark, rustaceanrob)
Unaddressed objection: node aborts on unhandled remote exceptions from notification callbacks (xyzconstant)
Approval from an account with no project history and no reason given (Big621)

categories.name: ipc
why: P1 because it unblocks multiprocess wallet separation and out-of-process chain indexing
External processes connecting via IPC currently have no way to read chain data or follow events
